## Checklist

- [ ] The change is small and focused
- [ ] `swift build -c release` and `scripts/build-app.sh` pass
- [ ] I tested by hand (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] UI change: I checked light and dark mode with render mode and updated `docs/images` if needed
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) and `docs/BEHAVIOR.md` if behavior changed
- [ ] No telemetry, no network calls, no personal data
